scope: Preflight and exact fixture inventory only. No imports, cloud calls, paid LLM, product edits or infrastructure installation.
constraint: macOS host has no working Linux/container runtime. V8 heap cap or sampled RSS watchdog does not establish a hard process/cgroup 512 MiB budget. Do not claim Mac capacity as Render capacity.
